data_descriptions: date_time = time in US Mountain Standard Time
day_id = unique day id number for each drought period
wet_dry = denotes whether or not a meaningful amount of precipitation was recieved on each day
tree_id = denotes tree id number, as used in manuscript
dendrometer = tree volume (m^3) esimated from dendromerter band
daily_release = total water release each day (estimated from dendrometer band) (kg day^-1)
SW_REL_REC = SW_REL (when daytime and negative) or SW_REC (when nighttime and positive) (m3/s)
daily_rel_frac = fractional contribution of tree water to whole-tree transpiration on each day
NEE_over_under = overstory (30 m) + understory (2 m) carbon flux (gap-filled using REddyProc R library) (umol m^-3 s^-1)
NEE_under = understory (2 m) carbon flux (gap-filled using REddyProc R library) (umol m^-3 s^-1)
FH2O_over_under = overstory (30 m) + understory (2 m) water vapor flux (gap-filled using REddyProc R library) (mmol m^-3 s^-1)
FH2O_under = understory (2 m) water vapor flux (gap-filled using REddyProc R library) (mmol m^-3 s^-1)
CO2_only_over = overstory (only) carbon flux (gap-filled using REddyProc R library) (umol m^-3 s^-1)
H2O_only_over = overstory (only) watern flux (gap-filled using REddyProc R library) (mmol m^-3 s^-1)
RH_above = relative humidity (percent) measure above canopy
RH_below = relative humidity (percent) measured within canopy
TA_above = temp in celsius measured above canopy
TA_below = temp in celsius measured within canopy
VPD_above = vapor pressure deficit measured above canopy (kPa)
shortwave_in_below = shortwave radiation measured below the canopy (W m^-2)
shortwave_in_above = shortwave radiation measured above the canopy (W m^-2)
SWC_5 = soil water fraction (v/v) measured at 5 cm depth
SWC_10 = soil water fraction (v/v) measured at 10 cm depth
SWC_20 = soil water fraction (v/v) measured at 20 cm depth
